diagnosis_causal_explanation: adopt calls adjust_namespace with the owner namespace None; adjust_namespace then calls _guess_owner(None), which raises LookupError outside a handler context, so adoption fails before a valid manifest completes.

planned_changes.semantic_action: In adjust_namespace add a keyword-only parameter owner (default None). When namespace is None and owner is provided, derive the namespace from owner['metadata']['namespace'] instead of calling _guess_owner(None); if the derived namespace is still None (cluster-scoped owner), return without raising and assign no namespace to any child. Keep the existing _guess_owner(None) + LookupError path unchanged for callers that pass no owner.

In adopt, pass the already-resolved real_owner into the new keyword-only owner parameter of adjust_namespace (adjust_namespace(objs, forced=forced, namespace=real_owner_namespace, owner=real_owner)) so the wrapper does not perform a second owner guess for an explicitly supplied cluster-scoped owner.

actual_precondition_review.condition: Outside a handler, resolving an owner when none is passed raises LookupError; namespace resolution must not depend on that raise for an explicitly supplied cluster-scoped owner.
actual_precondition_review.rationale: This guard is the exact source-supported raise that V1 travels through. P1's public-plan check confirms adopt completes for the namespace-less owner via the new owner parameter, which is the requirement-relevant condition at this boundary.
